# PDF.js 5.6.205

Unmodified browser distribution from the installed `pdfjs-dist` 5.6.205 package.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and asset-folder notices.

`build/pdf.min.mjs` is served as `pdf.mjs`, and `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs` as
`pdf.worker.mjs`. Standard fonts, CMaps, ICC profiles and WebAssembly decoders are
included for self-contained previews. No document is sent to a third-party viewer.

SHA256 hashes are recorded in SHA256SUMS.txt.
